description: This file defines the ProjectStoryForm class, a PHP form processor for handling the input and validation of project story data in the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It includes form creation, validation constraints, and save logic for project stories.

classes.name: ProjectStoryForm
classes.description: Form processor class for handling project story submissions, including validation, form creation, and saving logic.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for specified form fields, ensuring they are not blank or meet regex requirements.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the form with fields for title, description, image, and pool image, adding constraints and settings based on read-only status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and processes the form data, updates the model, and handles errors during save.
